importTransaksi.title: Import Transactions via Excel
importTransaksi.formatHint: Column format: Tanggal, Kode Akun, Akun, Debit, Credit, Catatan, Kontak. Rows sharing the same date (blank date rows below it) are treated as one compound transaction. Maximum 5000 transactions. Account codes must already exist in Master Data → Accounts (COA). The Kontak (Contact) column is optional - if filled with an existing contact's name AND the transaction touches a Receivable/Payable category account, it's automatically recorded as a real Receivable/Payable transaction (not just General) and shows up directly in the Receivables/Payables report.
importTransaksi.errMaxRows: Max 5000 transactions per import. This file has {{count}} transactions.
importTransaksi.rowUnknownCode: Row {{row}}: account code "{{code}}" not found in COA

aset.autoCreatedHint: Assets appear here automatically once you record a transaction that debits a "Fixed Assets" category account (via the Transactions menu). Here you just configure its depreciation schedule.

aset.autoPostingHint: Fill in a start date + depreciation accounts below to have the system automatically record the depreciation entry every month (via the Recurring Transactions menu) - not just calculated for display.
aset.autoPostingExplain: Fill in the 2 accounts below to enable automatic monthly posting (recorded as a Recurring Transaction, viewable/pausable from the Recurring Transactions menu).

tutupBuku.title: Year-End Closing
tutupBuku.viewerNotice: Only the Owner can perform a year-end closing. You can view the history below.
tutupBuku.explainer: This process will zero out the balances of all Revenue and Expense accounts from{{since}} through the date you select, then transfer the difference (net profit/loss) to the Retained Earnings account. Once closed, you can no longer add/edit transactions on or before the closing date. Only admins can do this, and this action cannot be undone.
tutupBuku.confirmMsg: ⚠️ Are you sure? This can't be undone. Click once more to confirm.
tutupBuku.successMsg: Year-end closing successful! This period's net profit/loss has been moved to "Retained Earnings".
